findings.finding: Management guided in two primary documents that churn is lower entering Q3 and that ARR growth will accelerate in H2 2026 from Q2's +1.1 MSEK q/q, so the release has a company-set ARR bar to clear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ARR is the line this stock trades on: the 1 Oct 2025 ARR update (+1.0 q/q) fell -7.35%; the Q1 2026 report with flat ARR fell -4.0%; the Q2 pre-release with ARR back to growth plus a margin beat rose +13.2%
findings.why_not_priced: It is the company's own public guide, so it lands inside what the market was told and is sized near zero. What is not priced is whether Q3, seasonally the slowest ARR quarter (+1.0 in Q3 2025), actually delivers it. The stock has been flat at 28.4-30.5 SEK since August, with no pre-release either way.
findings.independence: Kalqyl's 2026-07-23 note repeats the guide but is management-sourced (https://storage.mfn.se/3a0cc37e-6b89-4480-876f-3cb1ad425819/upsales-technology-rapportkommentar-q226.pdf); Placera 2026-07-05 quotes the same CEO line (https://www.placera.se/analys/upsales-lag-vardering--hog-marginal-2026-07-05). Not independent of the company

findings.finding: Q3 2026 is the first full quarter with no Aira costs at all, on top of the Q3 seasonal cost dip (Q3 2025 personnel 14.5 vs Q2 17.9 MSEK). Reported EBITDA should step from 13.4 MSEK (35.1%, with Aira) to roughly 18-20 MSEK, a headline EBITDA and EPS jump well above the >35% guide, though Kalqyl already models 19.8 (47.2%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin surprises have been paid: Q2 2026 pre-release with 36-38% vs >35% guide +13.2% (2026-07-02); Q3 2025 report with 35.1% margin +8.05% (2025-10-22)
findings.original_quote: EBITDA ... 19,8 ... EBITDA-marginal ... 47,2% (Q3E, Estimat för 2026E table); 'Efter avknoppningen står Upsales med en betydligt effektivare kostnadsbas, där kostnaderna för uppbyggnaden av Aira inte längre belastar koncernens resultat.' [After the spin-off Upsales has a much more efficient cost base, with the cost of building Aira no longer weighing on group results.]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the one commissioned analyst has it, but the company's own guide is only >35%, and the stock at ~7x run-rate EBITDA (Placera, Kalqyl's 9.6x 2026E against peers at 20.7x) does not look like a market paying for 45%+. If it were priced, the stock would have re-rated after the Q2 report rather than holding 28-30 SEK for three months. Capped small because the bar is single-sourced and my cost reconstruction matches Kalqyl's, not beats it.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 income statement in the Q2 2026 report and Q3 2025 release show the seasonal cost dip (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bd95859a74fa6ecb5c946ebb0a2a639da&lang=en&src=listed); same company, different document

findings.finding: The ARR line has under-delivered the only analyst twice running: Kalqyl expected Q2 ARR 158.6 against 154.0 actual (+5.7 vs +1.1 q/q), and management itself said upsell into the existing base is still held back by a more cautious investment climate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ARR disappointments were sold: 1 Oct 2025 ARR update -7.35%; Q1 2026 report (ARR -0.1 q/q) -4.0%
findings.original_quote: 'Rapporten inkom starkare än väntat på alla plan, bortsett från ARR-utvecklingen som var något svagare än våra förväntningar.' ... 'merförsäljningen till den befintliga kundbasen fortsatt påverkas av ett mer försiktigt investeringsklimat' [The report beat on every line except ARR, which was somewhat weaker than we expected ... upsell to the existing base is still affected by a more cautious investment climate]
findings.why_not_priced: Kalqyl has since cut its Q3E ARR inflow to +1.5, so part of this is reset. What is not priced is that the company's 'acceleration' language has been wrong once already (Q1 flat after 'converge' guidance), and Q3 is the vacation quarter. A market pricing a miss would show a fading stock or shorts building; the stock rose +3.2% in five days and no short is disclosed.

findings.finding: This is the first report under CEO Johan Kallblad, whose warrant participation institutional holders blocked in August (it needed 9/10 of votes) and which a re-convened EGM approved on 22 September. A new CEO's first quarter carries risk of an expectations reset or new targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CEO-change announcement with the founder's sale of 5.6m shares fell -11.5% (2026-05-29); no prior report under this CEO
findings.original_quote: 'Av förhandsregistrerade röster från institutionella investerare står det klart att förslaget under punkt 9 ... inte kommer att uppnå erforderlig majoritet vid stämman.' [Pre-registered votes from institutional investors make clear that item 9 will not reach the required majority]
findings.why_not_priced: An inference about behaviour, not a document, so it is sized small. Kallblad's Exsitec record is cost discipline (Kalqyl), which argues against a kitchen-sink, so the sign is weak.
